criteria.reason: Explains all three pillars, 3a mechanics, tax effect and decision factors at the requested depth.
Core structure correct but several factual errors on 3a withdrawal rules, women's retirement age and permit requirements.
Clear headers, bullets and summary make the system navigable for a newcomer, despite length.

position: Defer 3a until emergency fund and long-term residency plans are settled
factual_errors: Women's retirement age described as 'slightly later' than men's; it is 64, earlier than men's 65.
Claims 3a cannot be withdrawn for anything other than retirement; early withdrawal is permitted for home purchase, emigration and self-employment.
Early withdrawal described as incurring 'steep taxes and penalties'; payouts are in fact taxed at a reduced rate.
States an L or B permit is required to contribute; any person with AHV-taxed income may contribute.
Credit Suisse cited as a current bank option; it was absorbed by UBS in 2023.
summary: Comprehensive, well-structured explanation of the three pillars and 3a with sound decision factors, but marred by several factual errors on withdrawal rules, retirement ages and eligibility.
